# Behror Solar

> BehrorSolar.in is Global Green Energy's local solar platform for Behror, Neemrana and surrounding areas. Behror Solar was founded and is led by Mahendra Yadav, a partner and investor in Global Green Energy.

Global Green Energy (GGE) is an Authorised Tata Power Solaroof Channel Partner and registered PM Surya Ghar vendor. All quotations, contracts, invoices and PM Surya Ghar vendor documentation are issued through GGE.

Mahendra Yadav — Founder, Behror Solar · Partner, Global Green Energy.

Based near Hanuman Mandir, Mohalla Nainsukh, Behror, Rajasthan 301701. Contact: +91 94144 53454 / myadav@behrorsolar.in.

## Service areas

Neemrana — Shahjahanpur - Residential - Commercial and Industrial

Based in Behror, 20 km / 20 minutes away.

Service areas: Jat Behror · Mundawar · Khairthal.

Additional service areas: Harsora · Tatarpur · Harsoli · Bibirani · Ghiloth · Mandhan.

## Residential system sizes

- [3 kW Solar System](https://behrorsolar.in/3kw-solar-system): 3 kW rooftop solar in Behror, Neemrana and across Rajasthan: official Tata installation at ₹2,00,000 or our custom Premier TOPCon system at ₹1,85,000. Central PM Surya Ghar CFA up to ₹78,000; eligible Rajasthan beneficiaries may receive an additional ₹17,000. JVVNL net metering handled end to end — compare generation, roof area and local installs.
- [5 kW Solar System](https://behrorsolar.in/5kw-solar-system): 5 kW rooftop solar in Behror, Neemrana and across Rajasthan: official Tata installation from ₹3,00,000 or our custom Premier TOPCon system at ₹2,80,000. Central PM Surya Ghar CFA up to ₹78,000; eligible Rajasthan beneficiaries may receive an additional ₹17,000. JVVNL net metering handled end to end — compare phase, generation, roof area and local installs.
- [10 kW Solar System](https://behrorsolar.in/10kw-solar-system): 10 kW rooftop solar for large homes and small businesses in Behror, Neemrana and across Rajasthan: official Tata installation ₹5,50,000 or custom Premier TOPCon ₹5,20,000. Residential PM Surya Ghar CFA is capped at ₹78,000; commercial economics shown separately. JVVNL net metering, generation, roof area and ROI compared.

Prices are all-inclusive, including GST. Three-phase supply is an additional cost for 5 kW Tata and Premier systems; the 10 kW options include three-phase supply. Exact costs follow a free site survey.

Recorded 3 kW-class generation (one unit = 1 kWh):

- [Tata generation — Alwar City](https://behrorsolar.in/3kw-solar-system#tata-generation-alwar): Six 590 W Tata panels, rated DC panel-array capacity 3.54 kWp. From 9 September to 8 October 2026 (30 days): total 521.1 kWh; daily average 17.4 kWh; peak 21.6 kWh on 9 and 10 September. Generation per rated DC capacity: 147.20 kWh/kWp over the period. Source: supplied generation chart and summary.
- [TOPCon generation — Behror](https://behrorsolar.in/3kw-solar-system#september-generation): Six 610 W TOPCon panels on an on-grid installation, rated DC panel-array capacity 3.66 kWp. From 1 to 30 September 2026 (30 days): total 529.13 kWh; daily average 17.64 kWh; best daily generation shown approximately 23 kWh. Generation per rated DC capacity: 144.57 kWh/kWp over the period. Source: monitoring-app September month view. This recorded six-panel installation is separate from the current five-panel custom Premier TOPCon option.

These records have different locations, dates and panel-array capacities; they do not establish a Tata-versus-TOPCon performance ranking. The nominal 3 kW system label is separate from the rated DC capacity calculated from all six panels.

Performance disclaimer: These figures are actual recorded generation from these specific installations and periods, not a generation guarantee. Solar output varies with weather, season, location, orientation, shading, grid availability, equipment and site conditions.

Exact module model, wattage and configuration are confirmed in the quotation. Premier/custom systems are separate from Tata Power Solaroof systems.

- [Hybrid Solar](https://behrorsolar.in/hybrid-solar-behror-neemrana): Hybrid solar with battery backup for Behror and Neemrana — grid-tied solar plus backup for power cuts.

The panel page also lists bulk DCR supply separately from installed systems. Minimum order one pallet. Prices exclude GST and freight. Contact us for current stock availability and exact freight charges to your location.

## Installation warranty and support

- 5-year full-system product and workmanship warranty
- 12-year module product warranty
- 30-year module performance warranty
- Inverter: 8 years for Tata; 10 years for custom solutions
- Local operations and maintenance support

## Subsidy and guides

- [PM Surya Ghar Subsidy](https://behrorsolar.in/pm-surya-ghar): PM Surya Ghar in Behror & Neemrana: up to ₹78,000 central CFA plus ₹17,000 Rajasthan support for eligible consumers, JVVNL net metering, documents and application help. The additional ₹17,000 Rajasthan–RRECL state subsidy applies only to eligible consumers enrolled in the 100/150-units-free Mukhya Mantri Nishulk Bijli Yojana.
- [TOPCon vs Mono PERC — Solar Quality and Long-Term Value](https://behrorsolar.in/topcon-vs-mono-perc-field-test): A lower-cost solar quote can cost more over time when lower output or weaker support erodes the upfront saving. High-quality Tata Mono PERC and premium TOPCon are both competitive options. September monitoring records compare the same budget and TOPCon arrays used in the August rooftop test; the Tata record is a separate Alwar City example.

Same-roof September 2026 generation, 1–30 September (30 days): premium TOPCon, six 610 W panels / 3.66 kWp DC, recorded 529.13 kWh (17.64 kWh/day; 144.57 kWh/kWp). Budget Mono PERC, six 530 W panels / 3.18 kWp DC, recorded 385.4 kWh (12.85 kWh/day; 121.19 kWh/kWp). TOPCon recorded 143.73 additional kWh, or 37.3% more raw energy; accounting for DC capacity, the observed difference was 19.3% per kWp. The same arrays had observed normalized differences of 16.9% on 21 August and 17.4% on 27 August. Separate inverters and unmeasured conditions prevent attributing the entire difference to cell technology. These records do not establish an annual advantage or lifetime savings figure.

The Tata Mono PERC Alwar City record uses six 590 W panels / 3.54 kWp DC and shows 521.1 kWh from 9 September to 8 October 2026 (17.4 kWh/day; 147.20 kWh/kWp). The location and dates differ from the paired Behror records, so it illustrates competitive high-quality Mono PERC output without establishing a matched Tata-versus-TOPCon ranking.
- [Solar Guides](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-guides): Solar guides and explainers covering subsidy, net metering, system types and panel technology.

For eligible residential systems above 3 kW, central CFA remains capped at ₹78,000. The 10 kW threshold relates to the simplified technical-feasibility/load-enhancement process, not a maximum subsidy-eligible system size.

Import and export readings are settled under the applicable JVVNL/Rajasthan net-metering rules. A correctly sized rooftop system can bring the payable electricity bill to ₹0 in some billing periods and can potentially offset electricity costs across the year. Actual results depend on solar generation, consumption and JVVNL settlement. Rajasthan's separate free-electricity benefits, where applicable, can reduce the payable amount further.
